name: Node.js & TypeScript
description: Techlio builds end-to-end type-safe APIs, real-time webhook middleware, and scalable backend services in Node.js and TypeScript.
h1: Type-safe back ends *in Node.js and TypeScript.*
answer: Node.js runs JavaScript on the server, and TypeScript adds static types that catch errors before release. Techlio uses them to build APIs, real-time services and integration middleware, often sharing types with a React front end so changes stay consistent across the product.

builds.title: APIs and services
builds.text: REST and GraphQL back ends with validation, authentication and tests.

builds.title: Real-time and webhooks
builds.text: Messaging, notifications and webhook handling for products that react to events as they happen.

builds.title: Integrations
builds.text: Middleware connecting payment, communication and CRM platforms to your product.

fits: Your front end is React and you want one language across the product
The product is real-time or integration-heavy
You value type safety across API and client

faqs.question: Node.js or Python for the back end?
faqs.answer: Node for real-time and integration-heavy products; Python where AI and data work dominate. Many systems use both.

faqs.question: Which frameworks do you use?
faqs.answer: Commonly NestJS and Express, chosen to fit the product and your team.
